targets.query:
SELECT
  val_nos_module_id AS Module,
  val_nos_name AS Operator,
  val_id AS Validator,
  val_status AS Status,
  val_balance / pow(10,9) AS Balance
FROM validators_summary
WHERE
  CONCAT(toString(val_nos_module_id), ';', toString(val_nos_id))
    IN arrayConcat([${nos_global_index_var}], splitByChar('|','${dvt_nos_global_indexes_var:pipe}')) AND
  val_status IN ['active_exiting','exited_unslashed', 'exited_slashed', 'withdrawal_possible'] AND
  val_balance != 0 AND
  epoch = ${epoch_number_var}
ORDER BY val_id, val_balance
LIMIT 1 BY val_id

targets.query:
SELECT
  current.val_nos_module_id AS Module,
  current.val_nos_name AS Operator,
  current.val_balance - previous.val_balance + ifNull(withdrawals.withdrawn, 0) AS GWei,
  current.val_id AS Validator
FROM (
  SELECT
    val_balance,
    val_id,
    val_nos_module_id,
    val_nos_id,
    val_slashed,
    val_nos_name
  FROM validators_summary
  WHERE
    CONCAT(toString(val_nos_module_id), ';', toString(val_nos_id))
      IN arrayConcat([${nos_global_index_var}], splitByChar('|','${dvt_nos_global_indexes_var:pipe}')) AND
    val_status IN ['active_ongoing', 'active_exiting', 'active_slashed', 'pending_initialized'] AND
    val_stuck = 0 AND
    epoch = ${epoch_number_var}
  LIMIT 1 BY val_id
) AS current
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT val_balance, val_id
  FROM validators_summary
  WHERE
    CONCAT(toString(val_nos_module_id), ';', toString(val_nos_id))
      IN arrayConcat([${nos_global_index_var}], splitByChar('|','${dvt_nos_global_indexes_var:pipe}')) AND
    val_status IN ['active_ongoing', 'active_exiting', 'active_slashed', 'pending_initialized'] AND
    val_stuck = 0 AND
    epoch = ${epoch_number_var} - 6
  LIMIT 1 BY val_id
) AS previous
ON
  previous.val_id = current.val_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    sum(val_balance_withdrawn) AS withdrawn,
    val_id,
    val_nos_module_id,
    val_nos_id
  FROM (
    SELECT val_balance_withdrawn, val_id, val_nos_module_id, val_nos_id
    FROM validators_summary
    WHERE
      CONCAT(toString(val_nos_module_id), ';', toString(val_nos_id))
        IN arrayConcat([${nos_global_index_var}], splitByChar('|','${dvt_nos_global_indexes_var:pipe}')) AND
      val_status IN ['active_ongoing', 'active_exiting', 'active_slashed', 'pending_initialized'] AND
      val_balance_withdrawn > 0 AND
      val_stuck = 0 AND
      (${epoch_number_var} - 6) < epoch AND epoch <= ${epoch_number_var}
    LIMIT 1 BY epoch, val_id
  )
  GROUP BY val_id, val_nos_module_id, val_nos_id
) AS withdrawals
ON
  withdrawals.val_id = current.val_id
HAVING (current.val_balance - previous.val_balance + ifNull(withdrawals.withdrawn, 0)) < 0 AND current.val_slashed = 0
ORDER BY GWei ASC, Validator
LIMIT CAST(${limit}, 'Int16')

targets.formattedQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, count() FROM $table WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
targets.query:
SELECT
  val_nos_module_id AS Module,
  val_nos_name AS Operator,
  block_to_propose AS Block,
  val_id AS Validator
FROM validators_summary
WHERE
  CONCAT(toString(val_nos_module_id), ';', toString(val_nos_id))
    IN arrayConcat([${nos_global_index_var}], splitByChar('|','${dvt_nos_global_indexes_var:pipe}')) AND
  is_proposer = 1 AND
  block_proposed = 0 AND
  val_stuck = 0 AND
  (${epoch_number_var} - ${epochs_range}) < epoch AND epoch <= ${epoch_number_var}
ORDER BY block_to_propose DESC, val_id
LIMIT 1 BY epoch, val_id
targets.rawQuery:
SELECT
  val_nos_module_id AS Module,
  val_nos_name AS Operator,
  block_to_propose AS Block,
  val_id AS Validator
FROM validators_summary
WHERE
  CONCAT(toString(val_nos_module_id), ';', toString(val_nos_id))
    IN arrayConcat(['1;0'], splitByChar('|','2;0|2;1')) AND
  is_proposer = 1 AND
  block_proposed = 0 AND
  val_stuck = 0 AND
  (222157 - 19) < epoch AND epoch <= 222157
ORDER BY block_to_propose DESC, val_id
LIMIT 1 BY epoch, val_id

targets.formattedQuery: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, count() FROM $table WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
targets.query:
SELECT
  val_nos_module_id AS Module,
  val_nos_name AS Operator,
  sync_percent AS Percent,
  val_id AS Validator
FROM validators_summary
WHERE
  CONCAT(toString(val_nos_module_id), ';', toString(val_nos_id))
    IN arrayConcat([${nos_global_index_var}], splitByChar('|','${dvt_nos_global_indexes_var:pipe}')) AND
  is_sync = 1 AND
  val_stuck = 0 AND
  sync_percent < (${chain_sync_avg_participation} - ${sync_participation_distance_var}) AND
  epoch = ${epoch_number_var}
ORDER BY sync_percent, val_id
LIMIT 1 BY val_id
targets.rawQuery:
SELECT
  val_nos_module_id AS Module,
  val_nos_name AS Operator,
  sync_percent AS Percent,
  val_id AS Validator
FROM validators_summary
WHERE
  CONCAT(toString(val_nos_module_id), ';', toString(val_nos_id))
    IN arrayConcat(['1;0'], splitByChar('|','2;0|2;1')) AND
  is_sync = 1 AND
  val_stuck = 0 AND
  sync_percent < (99.0234375 - 0) AND
  epoch = 222160
ORDER BY sync_percent, val_id
LIMIT 1 BY val_id
